body: Native scene-bundle backend: first in-game evidence (PID 23904, evidence/runtime/in-game/harness-scene_sequence-23904.json). Two scenes synthesized entirely by our writers (tools/scenebin/terrain_bin.py, navmesh_bin.py, build_slot.py) were deployed as owned pre-indexed slots Modules/MNBL.ProceduralWorld/SceneObj/mnbl_world_a (asymmetric calibration surface, 4x4 nodes x 64 m) and mnbl_world_b (FWGC seed 42 heightfield 129x129, 4x4 x 200 m, vertical scale 0.01). Scene.Read completed with no exception for both; GetTerrainData/MinMax/BoundingBox report our node grid and exact quantisation range. Heights: 28/28 calibration points within 0.028 m of the analytic surface; 25/25 seed-42 points within 0.024 m of the quantised grid under (c0,r0)-(c0+1,r0+1) triangle interpolation. RayCastForClosestEntityOrTerrain hit 53/53 at exactly the queried height (no crash). Navmesh imported 2048 faces with group histogram exactly as written (Plain 1914/Mountain 134; 1808/240); GetPathDistanceBetweenAIFaces found 3/3 routes on the calibration slot. One seed-42 route failed at face lookup (faceB=-1: 25 m navmesh cells vs rugged terrain exceed the lookup height tolerance; probe issue, not format). Limitation found: after a slot is read once in a process its terrain.bin stays locked (IOException on same-process overwrite), so world replacement needs alternating/unused slots. Decoder vs engine on official scenes: battle_terrain_001 0.024 m, NavalDLC Main_map 0.10 m. Also observed: module-qualified Read('Main_map','Sandbox') used SandBox scene.xscene with NavalDLC terrain.bin (binaries resolve by scene name, last module wins). Not yet shown: rendering of a generated slot, campaign map use, picking, wrap. Recon specs: docs/formats/terrain-bin.md, navmesh-bin.md, scene-bundle.md (independently verified, minor corrections recorded).
